Build Notes (Shared for all Variants)

Quill Volley is d4builds' second B Spiritborn build (after Stinger) [https://d4builds.gg/tierlist/ - 2026-09-16] and A on both Maxroll lists [https://maxroll.gg/d4/tierlists/endgame-tier-list - 2026-09-16] [https://maxroll.gg/d4/tierlists/push-tier-list - 2026-09-16]; InfinityBuilds does not list it [https://infinitybuilds.gg/en/tier-list - 2026-09-16]. It is the third distinct Spiritborn archetype by the site's tie-break. The endgame layout is d4builds' 'Quill Volley - Spiritborn (S15)' (September 14, 2026) [https://d4builds.gg/builds/quill-volley-spiritborn-endgame/ - 2026-09-16] [https://firestore.googleapis.com/v1/projects/d4builds-a3254/databases/(default)/documents/builds/af971588-26ae-44be-b58f-d61030c8c027 - 2026-09-16]: Rod of Kepeleke, Harmony of Ebewaka, Squirt's Blouse, Ring of the Midnight Sun, Aspect of Plains Power gloves, Ferocious Aspect amulet, 5-piece Berú of Rezoka's Rage + Protean Heart, The Hunter. Maxroll's (planner 5z3mhs0t) differs [https://planners.maxroll.gg/profiles/d4/5z3mhs0t - 2026-09-16]: Echo of Kwatli instead of Midnight Sun, Hesha e Kesungi and Temerity, The Protector and Rushing Claw on the bar, 2-piece Multitude + 2-piece Rezoka's Rage, Seal of the Golden Epiphany for push. Untested on this site.

Rotation
  1. Keep Ravager, Scourge, Toxic Skin and Armored Hide up, cast The Hunter on cooldown for extra Ferocity, stand in your Plains Power circle and spam Quill Volley into the pack at range, keeping Vigor topped up so every volley crits.
Variants

Leveling — Maxroll: 'keep up the buffs from Ravager, Scourge, and Toxic Skin at all times; Cast The Protector to pull enemies together...; Spam Quill Volley on the clump...; Spam Evasive Swipe until you reach the next group' [https://maxroll.gg/d4/build-guides/quill-volley-spiritborn-guide - 2026-09-16].
Move on when Move to Midgame once Harmony of Ebewaka, Hesha e Kesungi and an Echo of Kwatli charm drop (Astaroth / The Butcher).

Early Endgame — As leveling: Ravager, Scourge and Toxic Skin buffs up, The Protector to pull, spam Quill Volley on the clump, Evasive Swipe to the next group [https://maxroll.gg/d4/build-guides/quill-volley-spiritborn-guide - 2026-09-16].
Move on when Take the d4builds layout when you own Ring of the Midnight Sun and reach 100% Resource Generation with a 50% roll, and five Berú of Rezoka's Rage charms.

Late Endgame — d4builds: 'Maintain Armored Hide, Toxic Skin, Ravager, and Scourge. Cast The Hunter on CD. Spam Quill Volley.' [https://d4builds.gg/builds/quill-volley-spiritborn-endgame/ - 2026-09-16] [https://firestore.googleapis.com/v1/projects/d4builds-a3254/databases/(default)/documents/builds/af971588-26ae-44be-b58f-d61030c8c027 - 2026-09-16]
Move on when Push with the Maxroll layout once a Seal of the Golden Epiphany drops and you own Echo of Kwatli, Sepazontec and Fists of Fate as charms.

Pushing — Maxroll: keep Ravager, Scourge and Toxic Skin up, cast The Protector to pull enemies together, spam Quill Volley on the clump, Evasive Swipe to the next group [https://maxroll.gg/d4/build-guides/quill-volley-spiritborn-guide - 2026-09-16].

Stat requirements
  • Minimum Resource Generation: 100% + Ring of the Midnight Sun @ 50% - adjust to always recover 100% of your Vigor (d4builds)
  • Echo of Kwatli: +1 Vigor per full 10% Resource Generation on top of its base 10 - values between breakpoints do nothing (Maxroll)

Skills to select4 picks

  • Ground SlamCore skill
  • BastionIconic skill
  • InspirationPassive
  • Raheir's AegisPassive
  • Opportunity triggerThe ProtectorCast this and Aldkin steps in.
  • Reinforcement castsField of LanguishA Reinforcement only ever casts the base version of its skill and gains nothing from its own passives.

How to run them

Maxroll (d4builds' tab is the unfilled template): 'Raheir is used for the additional resistances from Raheir's Aegis as well as the damage bonuses granted by Inspiration when he uses Ground Slam or Bastion'; 'Aldkin is used purely for the Reduced Damage Dealt debuff' [https://maxroll.gg/d4/build-guides/quill-volley-spiritborn-guide - 2026-09-16]. The late-endgame bar has no The Protector (d4builds uses The Hunter) - trigger on The Hunter or on Skill Cast; unpublished which, re-verify.

Build Notes (Shared for all Variants)

Quill Volley is d4builds' second B Spiritborn build (after Stinger) [https://d4builds.gg/tierlist/ - 2026-09-16] and A on both Maxroll lists [https://maxroll.gg/d4/tierlists/endgame-tier-list - 2026-09-16] [https://maxroll.gg/d4/tierlists/push-tier-list - 2026-09-16]; InfinityBuilds does not list it [https://infinitybuilds.gg/en/tier-list - 2026-09-16]. It is the third distinct Spiritborn archetype by the site's tie-break. The endgame layout is d4builds' 'Quill Volley - Spiritborn (S15)' (September 14, 2026) [https://d4builds.gg/builds/quill-volley-spiritborn-endgame/ - 2026-09-16] [https://firestore.googleapis.com/v1/projects/d4builds-a3254/databases/(default)/documents/builds/af971588-26ae-44be-b58f-d61030c8c027 - 2026-09-16]: Rod of Kepeleke, Harmony of Ebewaka, Squirt's Blouse, Ring of the Midnight Sun, Aspect of Plains Power gloves, Ferocious Aspect amulet, 5-piece Berú of Rezoka's Rage + Protean Heart, The Hunter. Maxroll's (planner 5z3mhs0t) differs [https://planners.maxroll.gg/profiles/d4/5z3mhs0t - 2026-09-16]: Echo of Kwatli instead of Midnight Sun, Hesha e Kesungi and Temerity, The Protector and Rushing Claw on the bar, 2-piece Multitude + 2-piece Rezoka's Rage, Seal of the Golden Epiphany for push. Untested on this site.

Rotation
  1. Keep Ravager, Scourge, Toxic Skin and Armored Hide up, cast The Hunter on cooldown for extra Ferocity, stand in your Plains Power circle and spam Quill Volley into the pack at range, keeping Vigor topped up so every volley crits.
Variants

Leveling — Maxroll: 'keep up the buffs from Ravager, Scourge, and Toxic Skin at all times; Cast The Protector to pull enemies together...; Spam Quill Volley on the clump...; Spam Evasive Swipe until you reach the next group' [https://maxroll.gg/d4/build-guides/quill-volley-spiritborn-guide - 2026-09-16].
Move on when Move to Midgame once Harmony of Ebewaka, Hesha e Kesungi and an Echo of Kwatli charm drop (Astaroth / The Butcher).

Early Endgame — As leveling: Ravager, Scourge and Toxic Skin buffs up, The Protector to pull, spam Quill Volley on the clump, Evasive Swipe to the next group [https://maxroll.gg/d4/build-guides/quill-volley-spiritborn-guide - 2026-09-16].
Move on when Take the d4builds layout when you own Ring of the Midnight Sun and reach 100% Resource Generation with a 50% roll, and five Berú of Rezoka's Rage charms.

Late Endgame — d4builds: 'Maintain Armored Hide, Toxic Skin, Ravager, and Scourge. Cast The Hunter on CD. Spam Quill Volley.' [https://d4builds.gg/builds/quill-volley-spiritborn-endgame/ - 2026-09-16] [https://firestore.googleapis.com/v1/projects/d4builds-a3254/databases/(default)/documents/builds/af971588-26ae-44be-b58f-d61030c8c027 - 2026-09-16]
Move on when Push with the Maxroll layout once a Seal of the Golden Epiphany drops and you own Echo of Kwatli, Sepazontec and Fists of Fate as charms.

Pushing — Maxroll: keep Ravager, Scourge and Toxic Skin up, cast The Protector to pull enemies together, spam Quill Volley on the clump, Evasive Swipe to the next group [https://maxroll.gg/d4/build-guides/quill-volley-spiritborn-guide - 2026-09-16].

Stat requirements
  • Minimum Resource Generation: 100% + Ring of the Midnight Sun @ 50% - adjust to always recover 100% of your Vigor (d4builds)
  • Echo of Kwatli: +1 Vigor per full 10% Resource Generation on top of its base 10 - values between breakpoints do nothing (Maxroll)

Reasoning

HypothesisRod of Kepeleke turns Quill Volley into a Basic skill with no Vigor cost and crits every cast at full Vigor, and Quill Volley: Vulnerable Damage removes and reapplies Vulnerable on every feather, so Echo of Kwatli (10 Vigor per trigger, +1 per 10% Resource Generation) can refill the whole pool each cast [https://maxroll.gg/d4/build-guides/quill-volley-spiritborn-guide - 2026-09-16]. 3.2.1 raises Quill Volley 20% to 25%, Rod of Kepeleke to 1-1.2% per Vigor, the Talon glyph 15% to 25% and Sepazontec to 180-220%, and none of the Spiritborn nerfs (Tzic fix, Supremacy cap, Counterattack of the Swarm) touch this chain [https://news.blizzard.com/en-us/article/24295394/celebrate-30-years-of-diablo-in-season-of-hell-s-legacy - 2026-09-16] - so it should gain relative to the Counterswarm meta. d4builds' version instead leans on Rezoka's Rage Ferocity with Ferocious Aspect and Aspect of Plains Power [https://d4builds.gg/builds/quill-volley-spiritborn-endgame/ - 2026-09-16] [https://firestore.googleapis.com/v1/projects/d4builds-a3254/databases/(default)/documents/builds/af971588-26ae-44be-b58f-d61030c8c027 - 2026-09-16]; which chassis wins is the open question. Confidence medium: d4builds (B) and Maxroll (A endgame / A push) both publish Season 15 pages, InfinityBuilds does not list it, the two published layouts disagree on the whole talisman and half the gear, and it is untested here.
Confidencemedium
How to test it(1) Vigor refill on a single target: Maxroll says 'Quill Volley will generally apply 9 Echo of Kwatli triggers per cast... for a base of +90 Vigor', and Resource Generation between 10% breakpoints 'will do nothing' - test on a Lair Boss, not a pack. (2) d4builds' version drops Echo of Kwatli for Ring of the Midnight Sun: check its stated floor 'Minimum Resource Generation: 100% + Ring of the Midnight Sun @ 50%'. (3) Rod of Kepeleke's '+2 feathers' is 'currently bugged and doesn't work' (Maxroll FAQ) - do not count it. (4) Compare 5-piece Berú of Rezoka's Rage + Protean Heart (d4builds) with 2-piece Berú of the Multitude + 2-piece Rezoka's Rage + Echo of Kwatli (Maxroll Endgame) on the same tier. (5) The Hunter (d4builds) vs The Protector with Hesha e Kesungi pull (Maxroll): the latter needs 2-piece Multitude, 'Do not use this without the Berú of the Multitude two-piece set'. (6) Squirt's Blouse only keeps its bonus while Life is untouched - Maxroll adds it only after Temerity. Sources: [https://maxroll.gg/d4/build-guides/quill-volley-spiritborn-guide - 2026-09-16] [https://d4builds.gg/builds/quill-volley-spiritborn-endgame/ - 2026-09-16] [https://firestore.googleapis.com/v1/projects/d4builds-a3254/databases/(default)/documents/builds/af971588-26ae-44be-b58f-d61030c8c027 - 2026-09-16].

Rod of Kepeleke

Unique Quarterstaff

  • Your Core Skills are now additionally Basic Skills and free to cast.
  • When cast at Maximum Vigor, your Core Skills Consume all Vigor to cast at their largest Size, and become guaranteed Critical Strikes, with 0.50 – 0.60% increased Critical Strike Damage for each point of Vigor spent this way.

"Beyond the world disc doth lie the keeper serpent Kepeleke. Ceaseless the serpent grows, and thus must ever consume his own tail, lest the world be overtaken." - Lintel XII

Provoke

Iconic skillRaheir

Cooldown: 25 seconds

Raheir Taunts enemies around you for 5 seconds. You gain 5% Damage Reduction for each target, up to 20%.

Ground Slam

Core skillRaheir

Cooldown: 11 seconds

Weapon: Round Shield

Basic Attack: Shield Strike

Raheir brutalizes the ground, dealing 160% Physical damage and Slowing enemies by 30% for 6 seconds. Targets in the center of the slam are Slowed by 60% instead.

Selecting a Mercenary Core Skill alters their wielded Weapon and Basic Attack.

Raheir swings a round shield at enemies, dealing 85% Physical damage. Every 20 swings, Raheir Heals you for 8% of your Maximum Life.

Shield Charge

Core skillRaheir

Cooldown: 11 seconds

Weapon: Tower Shield

Basic Attack: Shield Bash

Raheir rushes forward aggressively, dealing 110% Physical damage and Taunting nearby enemies for 4 seconds.

Selecting a Mercenary Core Skill alters their wielded Weapon and Basic Attack.

Raheir bashes enemies with a tower shield, dealing 80% Physical damage and Fortifying you for 0.2% of your Maximum Life.

Crater

Iconic skillRaheir

Cooldown: 22 seconds

Raheir strikes the ground 3 times, each burst dealing 30% Physical damage and Pulling In enemies. The final burst deals 40% more Physical damage and additionally Stuns enemies for 2 secondseconds.

Raheir's Guard

PassiveRaheir

Raheir grants you 15%[+] Armor.

Vanguard

PassiveRaheir

Raheir Slows surrounding enemies by 40%.

Mocking Lure

PassiveRaheir

You deal 15%[x] increased damage to enemies Taunted by Raheir.

Iron Wolf's Ward

PassiveRaheir

When Raheir's Valiance is triggered, he Knocks Back Close enemies and Taunts Distant enemies for 4 seconds.

Raheir's Valiance Cooldown is reduced by 35%.

Iron Wolf's Call

PassiveRaheir

When Raheir's Valiance is triggered, your next 4 Core Skills within 10 seconds deal 25%[x] increased damage and cost no Resource.

Raheir's Valiance Cooldown is reduced by 25%.

Sundering Shield

PassiveRaheir

Raheir's final Crater burst deals 200%[x] increased damage and inflicts Vulnerable on enemies for 4 seconds.

Shield Throw

Iconic skillRaheir

Cooldown: 22 seconds

Raheir throws his shield, dealing 450% Physical damage and Taunting enemies for 5 seconds. The shield bounces up to 9 times and cannot bounce to the same target twice.

Iron Wolf's Arrival

PassiveRaheir

When Raheir's Valiance is triggered, he also casts Ground Slam and Shield Throw.

Raheir's Valiance's Cooldown is reduced by 35%.

Consecrated Shield

PassiveRaheir

Raheir's Shield Throw Consecrates enemies for 6 seconds. Directly damaging a Consecrated enemy Heals you for 6% of your Maximum Life, once per target.

Bastion

Iconic skillRaheir

Cooldown: 30 seconds

Raheir takes a protective position for 5 seconds, redirecting 90% of the damage that would be dealt to surrounding allies to himself for 5 seconds.

Bastion's initial cast also grants surrounding allies Unstoppable for 1.0 secondseconds.

Iron Wolf's Virtue

PassiveRaheir

When Raheir's Valiance is triggered, he Heals you for 25% of your Maximum Life.

Raheir's Valiance Cooldown is reduced by 35%.

Inspiration

PassiveRaheir

Enemies affected by Raheir's Ground Slam take 15%[x] increased damage.

Allies affected by Raheir's Bastion deal 25%[x] increased damage.

Raheir's Aegis

PassiveRaheir

Raheir grants you 15% Resistance to All Elements.

Draw Fire

PassiveRaheir

When you use a Healing Potion, Raheir Taunts enemies around him for 4 seconds. Can only occur once every 20 seconds.
